sql:
with tk as (select o.market_ticker, min(o.strategy) strategy, count(distinct o.strategy) ns from live_orders o where o.action='buy' and o.created_at >= now() - interval '21 days' and exists(select 1 from fills f where f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id) group by o.market_ticker),
nw as (select distinct on (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, p.realized_pnl, coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity::numeric) q from positions p join tk using(market_ticker) order by p.market_ticker, p.captured_at desc),
fl as (select p.market_ticker, min(p.captured_at) flat_at from positions p join tk using(market_ticker) where coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity::numeric)=0 group by 1)
select tk.strategy, date(fl.flat_at) d, count(*) n, round(sum(nw.realized_pnl),2) pnl, sum(case when nw.realized_pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) losers, round(min(nw.realized_pnl),2) worst, max(tk.ns) max_ns from tk join nw using(market_ticker) join fl using(market_ticker) where nw.q=0 group by 1,2 order by 2 desc,1
